'''January 2005 College Station tournament''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG local tournament held on Sunday 9 January 2005 at 12:00 PM at a private home in College Station, Texas, for the release of [[Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court|Virtual Set 8]], with [[Mike Richards|Michael Richards]] as tournament director.<ref name="pcf-4326-59247">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=59247#59247 ANOTHER Texas Tournament! 01/09/2005], Michael Richards (mr007agent), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (1 January 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050217013713/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=59247%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> It was a constructed Swiss tournament with an unlimited card pool, of two or three rounds and no final confrontation, with a $5 entry fee; two uncut sheets were announced as prizes.<ref name="pcf-4326-59247" />

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' College Station, Texas<ref name="pcf-4326-59247" />
* '''Dates:''' 9 January 2005<ref name="pcf-4326-59247" />
* '''Format:''' constructed, unlimited card pool; Swiss, two or three rounds<ref name="pcf-4326-59247" />
* '''Entry:''' $5<ref name="pcf-4326-59247" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Mike Richards|Michael Richards]]<ref name="pcf-4326-59247" />

== Results ==

No results were posted in the Players Committee forum topic.
